630	function readBlockScalar (state: ParserState, parentIndent: number, props: NodeProperties) {
631	  const ch = state.input.charCodeAt(state.position)
632	  let chomping: ChompingMode = CHOMPING_MODE.CLIP
633	  let indent = -1
634	  let detectedIndent = false
635	
636	  if (ch !== 0x7C/* | */ && ch !== 0x3E/* > */) return false
637	
638	  const style = ch === 0x7C/* | */ ? SCALAR_STYLE.LITERAL_BLOCK : SCALAR_STYLE.FOLDED_BLOCK
639	  state.position++
640	
641	  while (state.input.charCodeAt(state.position) !== 0) {
642	    const current = state.input.charCodeAt(state.position)
643	    const digit = fromDecimalCode(current)
644	
645	    if (current === 0x2B/* + */ || current === 0x2D/* - */) {
646	      if (chomping !== CHOMPING_MODE.CLIP) throwError(state, 'repeat of a chomping mode identifier')
647	      chomping = current === 0x2B/* + */ ? CHOMPING_MODE.KEEP : CHOMPING_MODE.STRIP
648	      state.position++
649	    } else if (digit >= 0) {
650	      if (digit === 0) {
651	        throwError(state, 'bad explicit indentation width of a block scalar; it cannot be less than one')
652	      }
653	      if (detectedIndent) throwError(state, 'repeat of an indentation width identifier')
654	      indent = parentIndent + digit - 1
655	      detectedIndent = true
656	      state.position++
657	    } else {
658	      break
659	    }
660	  }
661	
662	  let hadWhitespace = false
663	  while (isWhiteSpace(state.input.charCodeAt(state.position))) {
664	    hadWhitespace = true
665	    state.position++
666	  }
667	  if (hadWhitespace && state.input.charCodeAt(state.position) === 0x23/* # */) skipUntilLineEnd(state)
668	
669	  if (isEol(state.input.charCodeAt(state.position))) {
670	    consumeLineBreak(state)
671	  } else if (state.input.charCodeAt(state.position) !== 0) {
672	    throwError(state, 'a line break is expected')
673	  }
674	
675	  let contentIndent = detectedIndent ? indent : -1
676	  let maxLeadingIndent = 0
677	  const valueStart = state.position
678	  let valueEnd = state.position
679	
680	  while (state.input.charCodeAt(state.position) !== 0) {
681	    const linePosition = state.position
682	    let column = 0
683	
684	    while (state.input.charCodeAt(linePosition + column) === 0x20/* Space */) column++
685	
686	    const first = state.input.charCodeAt(linePosition + column)
687	    if (first === 0) {
688	      // End of input acts as a line terminator, but there is no line break to
689	      // include here. A final all-spaces line still counts: when the block has a
690	      // content indent, the spaces beyond it are real content; in a wholly blank
691	      // block (contentIndent < 0) the spaces form a blank line that chomping must
692	      // see, exactly as it would if the line ended with a break. Capture the line
693	      // in both cases; otherwise the block ends at the start of this empty line.
694	      if (contentIndent >= 0) {
695	        if (column > contentIndent) valueEnd = linePosition + column
696	      } else if (column > 0) {
697	        valueEnd = linePosition + column
698	      }
699	      break
700	    }
701	    if (testDocumentBoundary(state)) break
702	
703	    if (!detectedIndent && contentIndent === -1 && isEol(first)) {
704	      maxLeadingIndent = Math.max(maxLeadingIndent, column)
705	    }
706	
707	    if (!detectedIndent && contentIndent === -1 && !isEol(first)) {
708	      if (first === 0x09/* Tab */ && column < parentIndent) {
709	        state.position = linePosition + column
710	        throwError(state, 'tab characters must not be used in indentation')
711	      }
712	      if (column < maxLeadingIndent) {
713	        state.position = linePosition + column
714	        throwError(state, 'bad indentation of a mapping entry')
715	      }
716	    }
717	
718	    if (contentIndent === -1 && first !== 0 && !isEol(first) && column < parentIndent) {
719	      state.lineIndent = column
720	      state.position = linePosition + column
721	      break
722	    }
723	
724	    if (!detectedIndent && first !== 0 && !isEol(first) && contentIndent === -1) {
725	      contentIndent = column
726	    }
727	
728	    const requiredIndent = contentIndent === -1 ? parentIndent + 1 : contentIndent
729	    if (first !== 0 && !isEol(first) && column < requiredIndent) {
730	      state.lineIndent = column
731	      state.position = linePosition + column
732	      break
733	    }
734	
735	    skipUntilLineEnd(state)
736	    valueEnd = state.position
737	    if (isEol(state.input.charCodeAt(state.position))) {
738	      consumeLineBreak(state)
739	      // Include the line break in the range so trailing blank lines are
740	      // preserved. This is what lets cook tell apart an empty `|+` (range "",
741	      // value "") from a `|+` with one blank line (range "\n", value "\n").
742	      // De-indent and chomping are applied later in getScalarValue.
743	      valueEnd = state.position
744	    }
745	  }
746	
747	  checkPrintable(state, valueStart, valueEnd)
748	  addScalarEvent(
749	    state,
750	    valueStart,
751	    valueEnd,
752	    props.anchorStart,
753	    props.anchorEnd,
754	    props.tagStart,
755	    props.tagEnd,
756	    style,
757	    chomping,
758	    contentIndent
759	  )
760	  return true
761	}

764	  const ch = state.input.charCodeAt(state.position)
765	  const inFlow = nodeContext === CONTEXT_FLOW_IN
766	
767	  if (ch === 0 ||
768	      isWsOrEol(ch) ||
769	      ch === 0x23/* # */ ||
770	      ch === 0x26/* & */ ||
771	      ch === 0x2A/* * */ ||
772	      ch === 0x21/* ! */ ||
773	      ch === 0x7C/* | */ ||
774	      ch === 0x3E/* > */ ||
775	      ch === 0x27/* ' */ ||
776	      ch === 0x22/* " */ ||
777	      ch === 0x25/* % */ ||
778	      ch === 0x40/* @ */ ||
779	      ch === 0x60/* ` */ ||
780	      (inFlow && isFlowIndicator(ch))) {
781	    return false
782	  }
783	
784	  if (ch === 0x3F/* ? */ || ch === 0x2D/* - */) {
785	    const following = state.input.charCodeAt(state.position + 1)
786	    if (isWsOrEolOrEnd(following) || (inFlow && isFlowIndicator(following))) return false

content.text:
I fixed the bug. The reported input now loads as `{ a: { oneOf: [ { type: 'string', example: '\n' }, { type: 'array' } ] } }`, the same result as 4.3.2.

**Cause:** in `readBlockScalar` (`src/parser/parser.ts`), the parser keeps track of how much whitespace the leading blank lines had. When it reached the first non-blank line, it threw "bad indentation of a mapping entry" if that line was less indented than those blank lines. That check ran before the check that ends the scalar. So a line like `    - type: array` or `  y: 1`, which should simply close the scalar, was treated as badly indented scalar content. An empty line with no spaces didn't trigger it, which is why that case already worked.

**Fix:** a one-line change. The check now only applies when the line stays inside the scalar (`column >= parentIndent`). Lines less indented than that fall through to the existing code that ends the scalar. The YAML rule that leading blank lines can't be more indented than the content (e.g. `x: |\n    \n  a\n`) is still enforced.

**Tests:** I added `test/core/units/load-block-scalar-blank-body.test.mjs`. It covers the reported example, the sibling-key case with `|+`, `>+`, `|`, `>` and `|-`, and the error case that must still be rejected. All core tests pass: 320 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. I couldn't run the yaml-test-suite spec tests because their fixtures aren't in the checkout and downloading them needs the network. I also tried to run eslint on the changed files, but that command was denied, so lint hasn't been checked.

result:
I fixed the bug. The reported input now loads as `{ a: { oneOf: [ { type: 'string', example: '\n' }, { type: 'array' } ] } }`, the same result as 4.3.2.

**Cause:** in `readBlockScalar` (`src/parser/parser.ts`), the parser keeps track of how much whitespace the leading blank lines had. When it reached the first non-blank line, it threw "bad indentation of a mapping entry" if that line was less indented than those blank lines. That check ran before the check that ends the scalar. So a line like `    - type: array` or `  y: 1`, which should simply close the scalar, was treated as badly indented scalar content. An empty line with no spaces didn't trigger it, which is why that case already worked.

**Fix:** a one-line change. The check now only applies when the line stays inside the scalar (`column >= parentIndent`). Lines less indented than that fall through to the existing code that ends the scalar. The YAML rule that leading blank lines can't be more indented than the content (e.g. `x: |\n    \n  a\n`) is still enforced.

**Tests:** I added `test/core/units/load-block-scalar-blank-body.test.mjs`. It covers the reported example, the sibling-key case with `|+`, `>+`, `|`, `>` and `|-`, and the error case that must still be rejected. All core tests pass: 320 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. I couldn't run the yaml-test-suite spec tests because their fixtures aren't in the checkout and downloading them needs the network. I also tried to run eslint on the changed files, but that command was denied, so lint hasn't been checked.
